sources.summary: Chamfered surfaces, warm hues and reinstated art deco features define the interiors of The Gentleman, a Sydney apartment remodelled by local interiors studio YSG. YSG carried out a complete renovation of the 95-square-meter, high-ceilinged apartment in a 1929 art deco building in the trendy suburb of Redfern, which has views of the Sydney Opera House. The post YSG draws on art deco for Sydney apartment revamp appeared first on Dezeen .
